Apply AppShell plus a back link/breadcrumb to profile, group detail, members, activity, groups/new, the signed-in join render, and the expense screens via components/expense-screen.tsx (which owns the <main>, h1 and back link the two expense pages share, so the shell lands there, not in the page files); both loading.tsx boundaries render the shell chrome above the existing skeletons keeping data-skeleton names and motion-safe classes. lib/auth, lib/money, lib/settle, lib/db and all validations stay byte-identical in behaviour.

work_order.debate_summary: The critique returned 'flawed' with 9 findings and I verified each against the source instead of applying them blindly. All 9 held up and were folded in, none dismissed: (1) blocking test-path gap confirmed in vitest.config.ts, suites moved to app/; (2) blocking lockfile gap confirmed via the sdlc:verify chain, package-lock.json added to files[] and AC-8 now runs sdlc:verify; (3) ExpenseScreen owns the expense <main>/h1/back link, so the shell lands there; (4) the signed-in join render had shell coverage asserted with no mechanism, now an explicit file entry; (5) both loading boundaries painted shell-less skeletons, now shell chrome above pinned skeletons; (6) ui.tsx's no-client contract is real and consumed by a server page, so stateful pieces move to a new ui-interactive.tsx island; (7) the h1 accounting was broken (shared header h1, h2-only SignedInHome), now decided: shell emits no heading, landing hero and a new Home h1 carry it; (8)-(9) two minor rationale falsehoods corrected (landing is dynamic via the session read; the font fallback does not survive a failed build fetch). issue_snapshot.title: Foundation, app shell, landing page and auth screens
issue_snapshot.body:
A visitor understands Tabs in seconds and reaches sign-up or sign-in in one click, and every signed-in page shares one navigable shell instead of orphan text links.

UI face: visitor sees the new landing page and the centred auth cards; signed-in user sees the shell (mark to Home, current place, account menu) on every page this piece touches. Contract face: this slice DEFINES the theme tokens, Inter via next/font, lucide-react dependency, and the shared component set (buttons, inputs including money inputs, segmented control, list rows, cards, avatars, badges, dialogs/sheets, toasts, skeletons, empty states) per docs/ui.md sections Theme, Patterns and Accessibility; later slices consume them unchanged. Behaviour, data model, money rules, TRs and all other decisions stay exactly as they are.

**Risk.** Touches the sign-in and sign-up screens; auth logic, hashing, sessions, and rate limiting are unchanged and review must reject any behaviour change there.

**Out of scope**
- Any behaviour, data-model, money-math, or API change
- Home, group, expense, settle-up, members, activity, and profile screen redesigns (later pieces)
- Dark mode

Covers: TR-11, S-8
Part of #31.

## Acceptance (from the split)
- **IAC-1** Signed-out visitor loads a marketing landing page with header mark plus Sign in, hero headline with one-line product story, primary Create account and secondary Sign in, three-step how-it-works, trust line, and footer with product links only.
- **IAC-2** No developer artefacts are linked or shown anywhere on landing, auth, shell, or footer: no /api/health link, no raw ids, no ISO dates, no UTC timestamps.
- **IAC-3** Sign-up and sign-in render as a centred card (max 420px) with labelled email and password, show/hide toggle, password-rule hint on sign-up, clearly labelled submit, and links between the two screens.
- **IAC-4** Signing in lands on Home, never on Profile; every signed-in page shows the app shell top bar with Tabs mark linking Home, current place, and account menu opening Profile and Sign out.
- **IAC-5** Every nested page reached from this piece has a way back (back link or breadcrumb); there is no dead end.
- **IAC-6** Auth loading and error states hold: submit shows pending spinner with double-submit impossible, failed sign-in preserves input and shows one neutral message that never reveals whether an email is registered.
- **IAC-7** Landing and auth at 375px and 1280px stack correctly with 16px gutters and 44px targets, meet the ui.md accessibility rules (labels, visible focus, one h1, contrast), and follow docs/ui.md tokens with Inter and lucide-react only.

Rewrite docs/ui.md into a complete, professional design system for the product this issue describes, following the project's frontend-design and ux skills: the full token set (neutral ramp, surfaces, accent, owed/lent/danger with tints, a type scale, the spacing scale extended where layouts need it, radius, elevation), the font loaded with next/font, one icon set named as a dependency, the shared component specs (buttons, inputs including money inputs, segmented control, list rows, cards, avatars, badges, dialogs and bottom sheets, toasts, skeletons, empty states), the app shell and navigation, and each screen's structure as this issue lays it out (landing, auth, home, group page with sections, expense editor, settle-up flow, members and invite, activity, profile) with its states. Record the redesign as a new ADR.
